text:
rachel_cs: Quick sync on NorthStar private deployment  week0 health + a few client asks that could impact renewal.

rachel_cs: Customer asks: 1) 13-month audit log retention (S3) 2) 90-day CMK rotation 3) allow two legacy CIDR ranges for their forwarder (ingress to our syslog endpoint) 4) temporary SAS token play for cross-account upload.

Tom_netops: Can confirm the CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/21 and 10.12.8.0/22. They said syslog over TCP/6514. Is that inbound through peering or a TGW attachment?

rachel_cs: They have a direct VPC peering with us per the contract. They want inbound so that their Splunk forwarder can push.

Tom_netops: Peering note: inbound requires route + NACL/SG change. Suggested minimal changes:

```
- route table: add 10.12.0.0/21 -> pcx-abc123
- SG: allow tcp 6514 from 10.12.0.0/21
- NACL: allow ephemeral egress 1024-65535 to 10.12.0.0/21
```

Tom_netops: This will open an audit vector; tagging + flow logs required. I'll draft the change doc.

Priya_iam: IAM: cross-account role idea sounds fine. We should avoid wide AssumeRole trusts. Recommend an assume-role policy limited to the forwarder principal and add permission boundary for only PutObject to their S3 prefix. Example snippet: 

```
Statement: [
  {
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::223344556677:role/splunk-forwarder"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0a1b2c3d"}}
  }
]
```

Priya_iam: Also suggest using short-term creds (STS) for the forwarder and requiring server-side encryption with the customer's CMK for uploads.

aaron_ops: KMS: current CMK (northstar-cmk) has rotation=false. Audit-bot?

audit-bot: KMS: northstar-cmk rotation=false | created=2023-11-15 | last_key_rotation=2024-08-20 | policy=restricted-ops

aaron_ops: To support 90-day, we have two options: 1) implement 90-day automated rotation in our rotation-service (approx 4 dev-days + validation) 2) have customer rotate keys in their account and supply rotated alias to us. Option 2 is faster but shifts operational overhead.

rachel_cs: Customer explicitly prefers us to manage rotation (they flagged compliance). This is a renewal risk if we push back. Danielle (AM) asked for cost delta.

Priya_iam: If we implement 90-day rotation, we must ensure KMS grants for any active encryption/decryption during rotation window. Recommend a temporary grant model plus a pre-signed alias swap procedure.

aaron_ops: Example grant CLI: 

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/northstar-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::223344556677:role/splunk-forwarder --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

rachel_cs: Regarding audit logs retention, storing 13 months of logs at their volume (~2 TB/month) will add ~26 TB of S3 storage + request costs. Need pricing note and AM escalation.

Tom_netops: Test plan suggestion: once peering route staged, ask their infra to push a sample syslog (one line) to our test endpoint. We validate reachability + TLS handshake.

Priya_iam: Docs ask from customer: they want a one-page runbook for cross-account logging, including: role JSON, example curl to validate TLS, KMS alias swap steps. I'll add to docs backlog and produce draft.

rachel_cs: Action items: 
- @Tom_netops: route/SG/NACL change doc + risk (ETA 24h)
- @Priya_iam: role template + prescriptive trust policy + docs stub (ETA 48h)
- @aaron_ops: KMS options writeup + rough eng estimate for 90-day work (ETA 48h)
- @rachel_cs: open commercial deviation ticket for 13-month retention + 90-day rotation premium and ping AMs

aaron_ops: One more operational caution: enabling inbound from their CIDR to our peered VPC requires us to update our flow log sampling and retention to ensure SOC2 meters capture it.

audit-bot: Note: flow-log-sample-rate increased to 1000 for vpc-logs-collector per temporary change request id=REQ-8743

rachel_cs: Renewal risk note: customer mentioned considering competitor if we can't meet rotation/retention without a charge. Let's make the commercial ask clear and offer a short-term workaround (customer-managed rotation + we accept rotated aliases) to keep momentum.

Tom_netops: I'll slot the connectivity change in the maintenance window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC pending tickets.

Priya_iam: I'll produce the role JSON and a stitched example of an assume-role test using AWS CLI and include example STS call.

rachel_cs: Thanks all. I'll consolidate tickets and link them here once created. Capture feedback: they said onboarding coordination was smooth but asked for clearer cost/impact callouts up front. I'll add that as a template change. :white_check_mark:
